notes.title: Valor Full Release: Coming November 3rd!
notes.notes:
The time has (almost) come. [b]Valor will go out of Early Access on November 3rd 2022![/b] To celebrate, a new gamemode will be added, sparking a new competition, the Valor November Championship!

[b]Does that mean no updates will come after that?[/b]
No! I still have lots of ideas to add to the game. The game will simply move to Full Release state.

notes.title: Valor 1.3.3b - Balance changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[h2]General Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*] All cooldown reduction stats are now capped at 70%.
[/list]

[h2]Runes[/h2]
The bonus values of runes you receive have been altered slightly. Note that these values only apply to new runes. Runes you already have remain unchanged!

[list]
[*] Ability strength runes: -15%
[*] Base health regen runes: +10%
[*] Basic attack heal runes: +15%
[*] Cooldown reduction runes: -10%
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Raven[/h2]
[list]
[*] Volley diminished damage for multiple hits on the same target: 70% -> 50%
[/list]

[h2]Evolution[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy Damage Multiplier per wave: 6% -> 7%
[*] Enemy Movement Speed Increase per wave: 0% -> 1%
[*] Bat Hatchery Damage: 100% of Attack Damage -> 70% of Attack Damage
[*] Butterfly Effect Normal Damage: 40% -> 30%
[*] Butterfly Effect Boss Damage: 2% -> 1%
[/list]
